value.rationale: A natural full-dimensional family of symmetric convex polytopes in every rank receives an exact, sharp fractional invariant with \(\sqrt n\) growth, a major quantitative contrast to the universal \(2^n\) bound. Its fixed-generic-direction incidence rigidity and balanced orbit illumination are structural, and the named regular truncated cuboctahedron has the exact previously unlocated value 16/5. The meaningful bridge from Coxeter normal geometry to exchangeable partial-sum persistence is neither an arbitrary finite slice nor a routine known-table calculation.
